No breaking changes this cycle — the one behavior change (401 vs 403) reads as a fix, not a contract break.

Now I'll draft the CHANGELOG entry in the file's established shape.
finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry into [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).**

Of 380 commits, only one feature and nine fixes touch users. Everything else was deps, refactors, tests, and CI.

- One `feat`: webhook deliveries now retry with exponential backoff
- Nine `fix`es, several repeated across modules: null cursors crashing pagination, double-trimmed trailing slashes, broken empty-allowlist handling, a duplicate HTTP header, full request bodies in logs, wrong latency units, leaky parser error messages, dropped trace ids on retry, and a wrong 403 on expired tokens (now 401)

No breaking changes this cycle. Worth a glance: the 401/403 change alters a status code some clients may branch on, so you may want to call it out more loudly than I did.
